question.text: What is the purpose of adding gypsum to cement?

options.text: To facilitate the hydration of cement
To slow down the process of setting
To speed up the process of setting

solution.text: When mixed with water the setting of cement takes place to give a hard mass. The is due to the hydration of molecules of the constituents and their rearrangement. Gypsum is CaSO4.2H2O. The purpose of adding gypsum is only to slow down the process of setting of the cement so that it gets sufficiently hardened.
